outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 48,882 live-born term singletons in vertex presentation born to mothers with diabetes
finding: Instrumental vaginal birth and intrapartum cesarean section were associated with increased odds of adverse neonatal outcomes, particularly the need for resuscitation, compared to non-instrumental vaginal birth in infants of mothers with diabetes, especially in the context of macrosomia.
mod_finding: Instrumental vaginal birth and intrapartum cesarean section were associated with increased odds of adverse neonatal outcomes compared to non-instrumental vaginal birth.
birth_weight: Macrosomic (birth weight ≥4000 g) and non-macrosomic (birth weight <4000 g)
